lines: Commit → PR → build → squash-merge → cleanup chain

card.summary: Full chain: commit → push → PR → build → squash-merge → refresh main → build → cleanup. Halts on any failure.
card.paragraph: The complete close-out for a feature worktree. Two build gates around the merge. Designed to be approved as one chain rather than step-by-step.
use_when: Feature branch finished, want one chain to merge & clean up
You want hard build-validation around the merge

extras.title: The chain
rows: On main; dirty unrelated; no remote

extras.title: Single chained approval
extras.html: One sentence covers every named step: "Commit these, push, open a PR, squash-merge, refresh main, clean up the worktree." Failures still halt; unexpected files still need a fresh approval.
